name: vision-it-infra
description: Portfolio catalog, invoicing, AI client email and double-entry accounting for an independent software studio.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend exec tsc -- --noEmit
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
